name: Abstract 3D Maximalist Pitch
tagline: Vibrant app pitch deck with chunky rounded display type, green and blue geometric fields, 3D-like CSS blocks, and maximal motion-graphic energy.

palette.description: White base with saturated green, electric blue, purple, yellow, and dark pitch-stage slides.

typography.style: Rounded chunky display type paired with clean geometric sans body copy.

best_for: Creator economy decks, media pitches, consumer app launches, event concepts, and bold marketing narratives.
avoid_for: Board updates, formal finance, legal decks, or clinical education where maximal 3D shapes would distract.

source_inspiration.name: SlidesCarnival Motion Graphics App Pitch Deck
source_inspiration.notes: Independent high-fidelity HTML/CSS reconstruction based on public preview thumbnails: rounded display type, green and blue graphic bands, saturated 3D-like forms, and maximal pitch layouts. No source assets are embedded.
